tips.title: Aligning Wings with Trumpeter Wing Jigs
tips.text: For Trumpeter kits like the 1/32nd Bf 109, use the wing jigs provided. Assemble the jig by inserting the wing halves into the U-shaped grooves. Glue the wings together, ensuring they're flush at the root. Once cured, remove the wings from the jig. If necessary, tweak the wing roots with a file or sandpaper.

tips.title: Assembling Multi-Part Gun Barrels (AFV Club)
tips.text: AFV Club kits often have multi-part gun barrels. To ensure alignment, insert a drill bit matching the barrel's diameter into the breech. Apply cyanoacrylate glue (CA) at the joint. Join the parts while aligning the drilled hole and the drill bit. Let cure, then remove the drill bit.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: Soak Eduard PE parts in warm water for 30 seconds. Pinch the parts to check flexibility. Use tweezers to place parts on the model, aligning them with the kit's locating points. Use a toothpick dipped in CA to tack-glue parts in place, allowing 5 seconds for alignment.

tips.title: Handling Resin Conversion Kits (Clear Prop Models)
tips.text: Sand Clear Prop Models resin parts with 240 grit sandpaper, progressing to 400 grit. Check for air bubbles and fill with CA glue. Prime with Vallejo Surface Primer to reveal any imperfections. Glue to the kit using Tamiya Extra Thin, checking fit with dry-fitting.

tips.title: Assembling Individual Track Links (Arma Hobby)
tips.text: Arma Hobby's individual link tracks require careful assembly. Join links with CA glue, holding them together for 10 seconds. Use tweezers to maintain alignment. Once cured, apply a thin coat of Vallejo Acrylic Thinner to the joint for a subtle seam.
